annotations.title: Strip hotel prices for a night

description: What a typical Las Vegas Strip resort room costs on a given night, against a quiet midweek night checked at a similar lead time (quiet_night: its price, date and when it was checked, the same one vs_quiet_night divides by; baseline_quiet_night_usd is a separate rough average), what drives it, and whether that night is one for hotel points or cash. If the night was not sampled, returns the nearest checked nights.
name: hotel_prices
title: Strip hotel prices for a night
